pages.text: A placed head gives blood once a day, dawn to dawn, unharmed: its usual tool, quality 70 to 95; 50 to 75 from a trophy or a hungry head. Staff lose 10 morale. Only the employer, and those they trust, may draw one.
A $(l)Leech Jar$() touching a plinth draws it once a day. A station draws its head; a Cerebral Array, its first head not drawn today.$(br2)$(o)The best donor is a head that cannot run away.$()
